# P37.18 — Map filters, In-view list, keyboard, mobile and print

**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/441_P37.18__map-filters-in-view-list-keyboard.md` · K1 MAP-03b · `live_verification=false` · gate: `none` · no OM-20, no production mutation
**Harness:** devin-desktop/swe-2-high/subagent · **Run ledger:** `docs/build/runs/P37.18.md`
**Owned §56 ids:** none — serves **SIG-UI-095** (canvas reachability/keyboard), **SIG-UI-102** (synchronised list), **SIG-UI-104** (filter counts + cannot-apply, C-03 grey-no-hatch), P36.37's owner rows.

## What lands

- **Filters over `sig.map-tiles/2`** — technology/vendor/operator/source/status/seen applied to the drawn site layers (`setFilter` expr over `tc vd oe sr f l st`) and to the In-view list; vendor/operator/source resolve through `sig.map-dict/1` (the `dictHref` prop is now consumed); fixtures mode keeps the named-never-faked note.
- **Browser cell re-sum (K1 §3.2)** — the `cells` layer re-sums per `(compartment, h3)` into the `sig-cells-summed` GeoJSON source on every view change; a single active sliceable facet sums its marginal prop (`t_<code>`/`v_<slot>`/`s1`); joint or unslicable facets honestly refuse.
- **Zoom honesty (C-03)** — an ACTIVE facet that cannot apply greys the drawn layers + a `role=status` note (no hatch); `effectiveFacets` drops it so map and list agree — unfiltered counts never pass for filtered.
- **In-view list/table** — tile-path rows (places z≤9 with registry-bbox frames + "1 source: N%", records z≥10 by distance, ≤50); the sortable **Table** view (J5, `aria-sort`); "Download this view" CSV with licence provenance (O3); the 1 s-debounced live region (§4.6).
- **Keyboard (J4)** — roving Arrow/Home/End in the list, Enter selects, Escape clears + returns focus to the invoking row, hover/focus highlight ring, selection scrolls its row into view, pan pad + MapLibre's own arrows kept.
- **Mobile sheet (§4.1)** — peek/half/full snaps, peek line "N records in view · Filters (k)", map padding tracks the snap; selection opens half.
- **Print (§5)** — a dedicated print block (the list, attribution, as-of, cite URL); the canvas/app chrome never prints.
